name: okf-memory
description: Serves an OKF memory (structural outline with line numbers) instead of reading oversized files in full.

max_bytes.title: Full-read size limit (bytes)
max_bytes.description: A full Read of a file larger than this shows Claude the file's memory instead of its content. 0 disables replacement.

memory_dir.title: Memory directory
memory_dir.description: Where memories are kept, relative to the project root. A source at path/to/file.ext has its memory at <memory_dir>/path/to/file.ext.md.
